basic_profile.bio: I'm a 25-year-old tech enthusiast from Austin, Texas, currently working as a junior software developer. When I'm not coding or debugging, I love exploring different hobbies, like building and customizing lightsabers. I'm single and enjoy spending my evenings diving into Reddit discussions or catching up on YouTube tutorials. My weekends are often reserved for volunteering at local charity events, which I find incredibly rewarding. I usually browse Reddit in the late evenings after work.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a degree in Computer Science and have been building upon my technical skills through online courses and self-teaching. My interest in lightsabers started as a casual hobby but has grown into a passion as I learned more about the tech and craftsmanship involved. I often research new technologies and trends online, which has helped me stay informed about various subjects.
